articles.summary: Enlarged group enters Q4 with approximately $93.1 million in Tekne program value, more than $200 million in management-estimated reactivation opportunities, 185 personnel across three Italian facilities, and June 30 stockholders’ equity of $10.1 million — above NYSE American equity thresholds DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU), the next-generation dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company, today issued the following letter from Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer: Dear Fellow Shareholders, On October 15, NUBURU closed the acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne S.p.A. (“Tekne”), materially expanding our operating industrial platform. On the same day, we filed a Form S-3 for the resale of shares related to our previously disclosed July offering. Following those announcements, I want to clarify the filing’s purpose, explain the industrial value Tekne brings and set out our priorities for financing and execution. The October 15 Form S-3 and existing conversion rights The October 15 Form S-3 is not a new capital raise. It was filed to register the resale of up to 20 million common shares issued or issuable upon conversion of the Series B preferred stock sold in our July public offering. Proceeds from that offering funded repayment of approximately $16.75 million of principal obligations under the December 2025 debenture and Lyocon acquisition notes. The filing itself issues no shares and raises no capital. It was made to satisfy previously disclosed registration obligations; it does not create new conversion rights. The industrial scale Tekne brings to NUBURU NUBURU today is a different company than it was ninety days ago. With Tekne, we own an established industrial business: approximately 185 personnel, three Italian facilities in Ortona, Poggiofiorito and Guastalla, a manufacturing history dating to 1990, and active customers across defense, civil protection, public safety and industrial markets. Tekne’s electronic-warfare and special-vehicle engineering now sits alongside Lyocon’s laser and photonics expertise and Orbit’s operational-resilience software. Together, these businesses provide revenue, production capacity and customer relationships from which to scale. Tekne gives us the production and systems-integration base to move our technology toward customer deployment and to pursue opportunities across Italy, the United States, NATO and allied markets, subject to qualification and applicable approvals. Our mandate is direct: integrate Tekne into NUBURU’s group processes, strengthen financial and operational controls, align procurement, production and commercial execution, and make successful configurations repeatable, with the aim of extending equipment sales through software, maintenance, upgrades and lifecycle support. New integrated mission packages remain subject to technical qualification and customer acceptance. A $93.1 million program base — and more than $200 million behind it Tekne’s September 14 production schedule carried approximately $93.1 million (€80.6 million) of remaining program value, as reported in our October 15 announcement. This preliminary, unaudited measure covers 100% of Tekne and includes items subject to options, frameworks or activation requirements; it is not closing-date signed backlog or a revenue forecast. Beyond that recorded portfolio, management estimates more than $200 million in potential program value from the reactivation of selected defense-vehicle and mobility programs, including previously withdrawn procurement procedures and terminated supply contracts. We believe completion of the acquisition strengthens the basis for pursuing these opportunities. This separate estimate is excluded from the $93.1 million portfolio. The opportunities are not current awards and remain subject to the relevant authorities’ decisions and definitive contractual arrangements. Our focus is conversion into deliveries, customer acceptance, recognized revenue and cash. NYSE American equity compliance update Our Form 10-Q/A reported June 30, 2026 stockholders’ equity of $10,130,320, above the $2 million and $4 million thresholds under Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii), respectively. We believe our reported equity meets those numerical requirements. We have submitted our quarterly update and supporting financial information to NYSE American, requesting confirmation of compliance with those equity requirements and conclusion of the related plan monitoring. The Exchange’s confirmation remains pending, and the compliance-plan period runs through October 29, 2026. We will update shareholders promptly upon the Exchange’s determination. Financing execution and growth Scaling an industrial defense business requires working capital: materials, components, production labor and inventory often require payment before delivery, acceptance and collection. Growth also requires investment in capacity, people and product qualification. Our financing strategy is to fund execution around executable customer programs. We are working with local banking partners and debt providers to structure working-capital and growth funding around production milestones and cash collection. Potential sources include receivables and inventory financing (on and off-balance sheet), equipment leasing, customer advances, debt and equity, subject to eligibility, credit approval and agreed terms. Completing an acquisition and financing the growth of the business it creates are two different requirements, and we intend to approach both with discipline. How platforms like ours are valued Across the public defense-technology market, some companies trade at substantial revenue multiples despite reporting negative EBITDA or adjusted EBITDA. In our view, this reflects the importance investors attach to scalability, differentiated solutions, customer adoption and the ability to turn technology into repeatable revenue. Orders demonstrate demand; deliveries and customer acceptance provide evidence of product quality and execution. Tekne gives NUBURU an established industrial and customer record on which to build, and we believe these factors should inform the assessment of the enlarged group. Historical results from before the Tekne acquisition do not capture the enlarged operating perimeter. Our investment case does not depend on Tekne reaching positive EBITDA in 2026. We acquired people, engineering expertise, technologies, licenses and an industrial and technology hub in Ortona — a strategic logistics location with access to a nearby airport and commercial port — to build an enduring Defense & Security platform serving Italy, NATO and the United States. The objective is sustained platform growth, disciplined financing and progress toward profitability and cash generation. What we will show you Our immediate priorities are to stabilize and scale execution at Tekne, align the group’s commercial and technology teams, and match production commitments to available funding. We will report progress in the terms that matter: confirmed awards and activations, deliveries and recognized revenue, margins, cash collection, financing, and share count — with a clear line drawn between firm orders, conditional program value and commercial opportunities. Tekne gives NUBURU the industrial base, customers and capacity to compete more broadly and begin scaling from established businesses. We believe the enlarged platform should be assessed on its acquired capabilities, customer programs and capacity to grow. Our responsibility is to demonstrate that value through deliveries, revenue, margins and cash generation, with the objective of building durable value per share. Thank you for your continued support. Alessandro Zamboni Executive Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer NUBURU, Inc. About NUBURU, Inc. NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is the next-generation dual-use Defense and Security integrated platform company. NUBURU is developing software-orchestrated, hardware-enabled capabilities for modern defense and security, critical-infrastructure and digital-resilience markets. The group combines operating businesses and technology-development initiatives across: directed-energy and non-kinetic technologies, including laser and photonics engineering for industrial and defense applications; electronic warfare, including cyber and electromagnetic activities (CEMA), and special-vehicle and defense-mobility programs; operational-resilience software, AI-assisted orchestration and analytics; and advanced manufacturing, integration, support and deployable-production initiatives. NUBURU is focused on commercial execution, integrating its capabilities and converting its opportunity pipeline into contractual orders, revenue and sustained business growth. Product-development and integrated mission programs remain subject to technical validation, customer requirements and applicable approvals. For more information, please visit our website at www.nuburu.net and follow us on X at https://x.com/nuburulasers . About Nuburu Defense LLC A subsidiary of NUBURU, Nuburu Defense supports the group’s Defense & Security platform and holds a 70% controlling interest in Tekne. Nuburu Defense Italy S.r.l. supports the coordination and development of the Italian platform. For more information on our acquisitions, investments and joint ventures: Orbit: www.orbitopenplatform.com – Orbit provides operational-resilience software, risk intelligence, data integration, workflow orchestration and auditability. Its defense deconfliction module remains under development and institutional validation. Tekne S.p.A.: www.tekne.it – Tekne serves defense, civil-protection, public-safety and industrial customers through electronic-warfare capabilities, special-vehicle engineering and manufacturing. NUBURU completed its acquisition of a 70% controlling interest on October 15, 2026. SunCubes S.r.l.: The group’s collaboration pathway with SunCubes supports exploration of laser power-beaming and optical-communications applications, subject to definitive arrangements, technical validation and applicable approvals. Maddox Defense Incorporated Joint Venture: The group’s joint-venture initiative with Maddox Defense supports advanced manufacturing and deployable-production and sustainment opportunities, subject to program development and execution. About Nuburu Subsidiary, Inc. A subsidiary of NUBURU, Nuburu Subsidiary, Inc. fully owns Lyocon S.r.l., an Italian laser-technology company specializing in the design, manufacturing and integration of laser systems. Lyocon supports NUBURU’s laser business and the development of dual-use industrial and defense applications. Forward-Looking Statements This letter contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. These include expectations about acquisition benefits, reorganization, integration, synergies, program reactivation and conversion, product development, market expansion, recurring revenue, capital availability, bank financing, NYSE American’s compliance review and determination, business scaling, financial performance and shareholder value. They reflect current expectations and are not guarantees. Forward-looking statements also include the preliminary management estimate of more than $200 million in potential program reactivation value and expectations regarding the enlarged platform’s market position and scalability. That estimate is not signed backlog, an award or a revenue forecast; the opportunities it describes are not current awards, and reactivation remains subject to the relevant authorities’ decisions and definitive contractual arrangements. It is excluded from the separately disclosed $93.1 million Tekne portfolio. The $93.1 million program measure is preliminary and unaudited, covers 100% of Tekne, includes items subject to options, frameworks or activation requirements, and is not closing-date signed backlog, recognized revenue or a forecast; deliveries, financing, customer acceptance and collection determine how much ultimately becomes revenue and cash. Its dollar translation uses €1 = $1.1551 as of September 14, 2026. The October 15, 2026 Form S-3 was filed to register the resale of common shares issued or issuable upon conversion of Series B preferred stock under its existing terms, as amended and previously disclosed; conversions under those terms may result in dilution to existing stockholders. Financing sources described in this letter are subject to eligibility, credit approval and agreed terms. General market observations regarding other companies do not establish a valuation for NUBURU. Actual results may differ materially because of integration and operational risks; losses, negative cash flow and liquidity needs; inability to obtain financing on acceptable terms; dilution; deferred purchase-price and earn-out obligations and potential acceleration; program changes, cancellations and procurement decisions; production, qualification, customer acceptance and collection delays; competition; regulatory, export-control, Golden Power and security requirements; listing-compliance risks; and other factors described in NUBURU’s SEC filings. Statements speak only as of their date; NUBURU undertakes no obligation to update them except as required by law. This letter does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities. articles.summary: Renegotiated terms cap the earn-out at €20 million, payable in cash with no share issuance for earn-out payments, while the waiver of approximately €29.7 million of shareholder loans and other receivables creates permanent equity in Tekne — giving NUBURU control of 185 personnel, three Italian facilities and electronic-warfare and defense-mobility capability in a $32 billion market DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) (“NUBURU” or the “Company”), a next-generation dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company, today announced that it has completed the acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne S.p.A. (“Tekne”) through its subsidiary NUBURU Defense LLC. The notarial closing was executed today in Italy, following the Italian Government’s Golden Power authorization granted on August 5, 2026. Tekne’s historical shareholders retain the remaining 30%. Alessandro Zamboni The economics of the transaction are the story. NUBURU acquired the additional 67.1% interest for a fixed purchase price of €5.2 million — €1.2 million at signing and €4 million deferred through March 2027. The transaction also provides for an earn-out capped at €20 million, payable in cash beginning in 2028 and calculated at 5% of Tekne’s annual U.S. GAAP revenues, with a guaranteed minimum annual payment of €2 million regardless of revenue, within the €20 million cap. The transaction also includes the approximately €29.7 million waiver of shareholder loans and other receivables which now become permanent equity of Tekne. The original cash-or-shares option has been eliminated: no NUBURU shares will be issued to pay the earn-out. In exchange, NUBURU takes control of a defense manufacturer founded in 1990, with approximately 185 personnel across three facilities in Ortona, Poggiofiorito and Guastalla; approximately $93.1 million (€80.6 million) of remaining program value on its September 14, 2026 production schedule; proven capabilities in electronic warfare, special vehicles and defense mobility; and a customer base spanning defense, civil protection, public safety and industry. The acquisition closes a 90-day sequence that has reset NUBURU’s foundation: approximately $16.75 million of debt retired in full from the proceeds of the $38.0 million public offering; a second consecutive quarter of positive stockholders’ equity with total assets of $69.12 million at June 30, 2026; the Italian Government’s Golden Power authorization on August 5, 2026; the return of BURU to NYSE American on September 14, 2026; and now ownership of the industrial base on which the Company’s Defense & Security platform will be built and delivered to Italian, U.S., NATO and allied customers. “We set out to build a vertically integrated defense company, and today we own the stack: directed energy through Lyocon, electronic warfare and vehicles through Tekne, operational resilience software through Orbit, and the factories to build all of it in a NATO member state,” said Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer of NUBURU. “We agreed to a fixed share purchase price of €5.2 million for the additional 67.1% interest in a 36-year-old business with a $93 million program portfolio, alongside the agreed recapitalization and cash earn-out. No NUBURU shares will be issued to pay the earn-out. That is the kind of capital allocation our shareholders should expect from us. Golden Power authorization from the Italian Government was a key milestone for this acquisition. Now we execute.” “Tekne’s Tactical Bubble electronic-warfare capability and its special-vehicle engineering are exactly the industrial layers our platform was designed around,” said Dario Barisoni, Co-Chief Executive Officer of NUBURU and Chief Executive Officer of NUBURU Defense LLC. “We can now take a requirement from a NATO or allied customer and answer it with our own laser source, our own vehicle, our own mission software and our own production line. Owning the full stack, inside Europe, is what customers are asking for and what very few suppliers can offer.” Transaction terms The revised agreement reduces the maximum aggregate earn-out payable to Tekne’s historical shareholders from €29.692 million to €20 million — a reduction of €9.692 million, or approximately 32.6%. The earn-out remains calculated as 5% of Tekne’s annual U.S. GAAP revenues for 2027–2036, with a guaranteed minimum annual payment of €2 million and no further payments once the €20 million cap is reached. Payments are made in cash by June 30 of each year beginning in 2028, replacing the original cash-or-shares option and eliminating earn-out-related share issuance. NUBURU and NUBURU Defense LLC are jointly and severally liable for the earn-out and fixed purchase price, and the earn-out is subject to contractual acceleration provisions. The fixed purchase price for the additional 67.1% interest is €5.2 million, comprising €1.2 million paid at signing and €4 million deferred in four equal installments through March 2027. Separately, the holder of the $1.74 million NUBURU convertible note issued as consideration for the initial 2.9% interest in Tekne will convert the note into 34,870 shares of NUBURU common stock under the originally agreed fixed-share terms, equivalent to a split-adjusted conversion price of $49.90 per share (approximately $50). At closing, NUBURU, also on behalf of NUBURU Defense LLC, irrevocably waived approximately €29.7 million of existing shareholder loans and other receivables, converting them into a permanent, non-repayable contribution to Tekne’s equity. The waiver materially strengthens Tekne’s capital base from day one while preserving the 70% / 30% ownership structure — NUBURU’s capital is already deployed inside the business rather than sitting as an intercompany receivable. Approximately $93.1 million in remaining program value, with reactivation upside on top Tekne’s management production schedule dated September 14, 2026 records approximately $93.1 million (€80.6 million) of remaining portfolio value across defense, civil-protection, public-safety and industrial programs. This figure is a preliminary, unaudited management operating measure relating to 100% of Tekne; it includes entries subject to option, framework or activation requirements and is not closing-date signed backlog or a revenue forecast. The U.S. dollar equivalent uses the September 14, 2026 ECB reference rate of €1 = $1.1551 and is provided for convenience. Beyond the recorded portfolio, NUBURU is moving immediately to pursue the reactivation of selected defense-vehicle and mobility programs, including previously withdrawn procurement procedures and terminated supply contracts. These contingent opportunities are excluded from the reported portfolio and are not current awards; any reactivation is subject to the relevant authorities’ decisions and definitive contractual arrangements. Additional commercial priorities include follow-on special-vehicle programs, electronic-warfare and counter-drone applications, and international defense-mobility opportunities, leveraging Tekne’s long-standing customer relationships together with the wider NUBURU group’s partner network. Full-stack control: lasers, electronic warfare, vehicles and software under one platform Tekne delivers the electronic-warfare and vehicle layers of NUBURU’s modular platform, including its Tactical Bubble capabilities and special-vehicle engineering. NUBURU is combining these with Lyocon’s photonics and laser engineering, Orbit’s operational-resilience software and the group’s deployable-manufacturing initiatives to field mobile counter-drone and electronic-warfare systems, command-support nodes and critical-infrastructure protection solutions. Orbit’s separate defense deconfliction module remains under development and institutional validation; integrated mission packages remain subject to technical qualification, customer requirements and applicable approvals. The platform’s commercial model is built to extend every equipment delivery into multi-year maintenance, software, upgrade and lifecycle-support revenue, layering recurring business on top of new system sales. Market opportunity and demand signals MarketsandMarkets estimates the global electronic-warfare market at $32.35 billion in 2026, growing to $64.66 billion by 2031. Grand View Research estimates the global anti-drone market at $4.1 billion in 2026, reaching $19.8 billion by 2033. These overlapping global market estimates provide context for the segments NUBURU intends to address; they are not additive and are not forecasts of Company revenue. Demand for interoperable, sovereign and rapidly deployable capability is accelerating across NATO and the European Union. NATO’s October 2026 DiBaX26 experimentation is testing resilient communications and the connections between counter-drone sensors, data feeds and effectors. On October 12, the EU Council gave final approval to the €115 million AGILE defense-innovation program to accelerate development and testing. NUBURU believes this focus on integration and deployment aligns directly with its strategy of combining Tekne’s industrial capabilities with software and photonics. New leadership for Tekne Tekne’s new governance structure provides for a three-member Board of Directors, with two directors designated by NUBURU Defense LLC and one by the historical shareholders, together with minority consent rights over specified reserved matters. General Pietro Serino, former Chief of Staff of the Italian Army, has been selected to serve as Chairman; his formal appointment remains subject to the required corporate and regulatory approvals, including ANAC approval. The selected Chief Executive Officer brings more than 30 years of experience across Italian institutions and the defense industry, including senior leadership roles in electronic warfare, cyber and spectrum dominance, and mission systems, with international experience across the Middle East, North Africa and Asia-Pacific. The Company expects to announce the CEO’s identity shortly, following the necessary corporate approvals. Regulatory and financial disclosures Tekne will maintain its registered office and its defense and security industrial facilities in Italy, in accordance with the applicable Golden Power requirements. NUBURU will provide additional information regarding the acquisition and file the related agreements in a separate Current Report on Form 8-K. The required historical financial statements, including audited annual financial statements, and related unaudited pro forma financial information will be provided in the Company’s SEC filings, including a Form 8-K/A as applicable, in accordance with SEC requirements. About NUBURU Inc NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is a next-generation dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company developing software-orchestrated, hardware-enabled capabilities for defense and security, critical infrastructure and digital-resilience markets. Its strategy combines directed-energy and non-kinetic technologies, electronic warfare and defense mobility, operational-resilience software and AI-assisted orchestration, and advanced manufacturing and support. For more information, visit www.nuburu.net and https://ir.nuburu.net/corporate-profile/default.aspx , and follow NUBURU on X at https://x.com/nuburulasers . About NUBURU Defense LLC A subsidiary of NUBURU, NUBURU Defense LLC supports the development of the Company’s Defense & Security platform, which now includes a 70% controlling interest in Tekne. NUBURU Defense Italy S.r.l. supports the coordination and development of the Italian platform. About NUBURU Subsidiary Inc A subsidiary of NUBURU, NUBURU Subsidiary, Inc. fully owns Lyocon S.r.l., an Italian laser-technology company specializing in the design, manufacturing and integration of laser systems. Lyocon supports NUBURU’s laser business and the development of dual-use industrial and defense applications. articles.summary: Established Italian manufacturer adds approximately 185 personnel and three facilities as management focuses on customer programs, deliveries and cash generation DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) (“NUBURU” or the “Company”) today highlighted the completion of its acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in TEKNE S.p.A. (“TEKNE”), its previously reported stockholders’ equity position, and its operating priorities as the Company’s NYSE American equity compliance plan period approaches its October 29, 2026 deadline. The completed TEKNE acquisition advances NUBURU’s transformation into an integrated defense and security technology business. TEKNE brings an established Italian defense manufacturer with approximately 185 personnel across three facilities in Ortona, Poggiofiorito and Guastalla, capabilities spanning specialized vehicles, defense mobility and electronic warfare. The Company’s October 22, 2026 commercial update reported categories totaling approximately $96.8 million of remaining order and program value in TEKNE’s September operating schedule. This preliminary, unaudited measure covers 100% of TEKNE and includes conditional items; it is not validated signed backlog, recognized revenue or a revenue forecast. Realization depends on program activation where required, production funding, delivery, customer acceptance and collection. With the transaction closed, management’s focus is on integration, execution and measurable financial results. TEKNE Acquisition Expands NUBURU’s Industrial Foundation NUBURU’s 70% controlling interest in TEKNE extends the Company’s operating presence beyond its historical laser technology business into established industrial manufacturing serving defense and security customers. TEKNE’s facilities, workforce and specialized technologies provide the industrial base for NUBURU’s integrated defense and security strategy, and create opportunities to coordinate TEKNE’s manufacturing expertise with NUBURU’s laser technologies and complementary software capabilities. Financial Position and NYSE American Compliance As of June 30, 2026, NUBURU reported stockholders’ equity of approximately $10.13 million, above the $4.0 million stockholders’ equity threshold identified in its prior NYSE American compliance disclosures. This marked the Company’s second consecutive quarter of positive stockholders’ equity, following a stockholders’ deficit of approximately $15.18 million at December 31, 2025. The Company’s compliance plan period under its NYSE American continued listing standards concludes on October 29, 2026. Any determination regarding the Company’s compliance status rests with NYSE American, and NUBURU will communicate material developments regarding its listing status through its established public disclosure channels. From Orders to Deliveries, Revenue and Cash With TEKNE in the group, NUBURU is placing increased emphasis on converting its industrial capabilities and signed order book into measurable business performance. The Company’s operational priorities are: Order execution: advancing customer orders through manufacturing and fulfillment. Deliveries: completing and delivering products and systems on schedule. Revenue realization: translating completed commercial activity into recognized revenue. Cash collections: driving working capital, customer payments and cash generation. Financial discipline: aligning operating expenditures and capital allocation with business priorities. The objective is straightforward: convert orders into deliveries, deliveries into revenue, and revenue into cash — building the foundation for sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value. Completed Milestones and Near-Term Priorities Completed milestones Completed the acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in TEKNE S.p.A. on October 15, 2026. Expanded the industrial operating base through TEKNE’s established Italian manufacturing operations. Added capabilities in specialized vehicles, defense mobility and electronic warfare. Reported stockholders’ equity of approximately $10.13 million as of June 30, 2026, above the $4.0 million threshold identified in prior NYSE American compliance disclosures. Near-term priorities Advance integration of TEKNE’s manufacturing and operating capabilities. Prioritize conversion of orders into deliveries, recognized revenue and cash collections. Develop commercial opportunities across defense mobility, electronic warfare, laser technologies and complementary software. Maintain financial discipline and oversight of capital resources. Provide shareholders with measurable operational and financial updates, including on applicable listing requirements. Management Commentary Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-CEO of NUBURU, commented: “NUBURU today is a fundamentally different company from the one that entered 2026. We have closed TEKNE, repaid approximately $16.75 million of principal under our December 2025 debenture and Lyocon acquisition notes, reported two consecutive quarters of positive stockholders’ equity and built an industrial platform with established customer programs. Our job now is execution — turning that platform into deliveries, revenue and cash — and we will keep shareholders informed on every material development, including our listing status, through our public disclosures.” Dario Barisoni, Co-CEO of NUBURU and CEO of NUBURU Defense LLC, added: “TEKNE provides the industrial foundation for connecting our defense mobility and electronic-warfare capabilities with laser technologies and operational-resilience software. Our focus is to develop integrated solutions around specific customer requirements, with clear responsibility for technical validation, delivery and support. We intend to build on equipment deliveries with software, maintenance and lifecycle services, creating more repeatable business across the platform.” Gianluca Trezza, Chief Executive Officer and General Manager of TEKNE S.p.A., said: “TEKNE brings established manufacturing capabilities, experienced personnel and specialized defense technologies to NUBURU’s industrial strategy. With the acquisition completed, our priority is execution — advancing manufacturing activities, fulfilling customer requirements and translating our industrial capabilities into measurable business results.” Transparency and Shareholder Accountability NUBURU believes shareholder confidence is earned through operating performance, financial transparency and consistent delivery against stated objectives. NUBURU will continue reporting material developments through its established public disclosure channels, with particular emphasis on operational milestones, financial performance, commercial progress and applicable listing requirements. About NUBURU Inc NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is developing a dual-use Defense & Security platform combining electronic warfare and defense mobility, laser and photonics engineering, operational-resilience software and AI-assisted orchestration, and advanced manufacturing and support. Its strategy is to integrate operating businesses and developing technologies into solutions for defense, security, critical-infrastructure and industrial customers. NUBURU’s operating capabilities include Tekne’s special-vehicle and electronic-system engineering, Lyocon’s laser expertise and Orbit’s operational-resilience software. Integrated mission packages and technologies under development remain subject to validation and applicable approvals. For more information, visit www.nuburu.net . articles.summary: Experienced defense executive to lead industrial execution and development of electronic warfare and special vehicle opportunities across Italian and international markets DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) ("NUBURU" or the "Company"), a dual-use Defense & Security platform company, today announced the appointment of Gianluca Trezza as Chief Executive Officer and General Manager of TEKNE S.p.A. ("Tekne"), effective October 26, 2026. The appointment follows NUBURU’s acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne on October 15, 2026, and places industrial execution and commercial development at the center of the next phase of integration. Gianluca Trezza Trezza brings more than three decades of experience across Italian institutions and the international defense industry. Following service in Italy’s Guardia di Finanza, where he attained the rank of Major, he held senior leadership roles at ELT Group, a major player in EW and defense industry, across the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and global business development. His experience spans electronic warfare, cyber intelligence, C4ISR and international industrial partnerships. His priorities will include aligning customer commitments with procurement and production, strengthening program controls, engaging the relevant Italian authorities on potential program reactivation, and developing Tekne’s electronic-warfare, special-vehicle and defense-mobility businesses. This mandate supports NUBURU’s strategy of combining Tekne’s industrial capabilities with the group’s photonics, software and systems-integration capabilities, subject to technical qualification, customer requirements and applicable approvals. “With Tekne now part of NUBURU, our priority is execution,” said Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-CEO of NUBURU. “Gianluca brings the sector knowledge and international experience to connect customer opportunities with industrial delivery. We intend to demonstrate progress through confirmed awards, reliable deliveries and the conversion of those deliveries into revenue.” “With Golden Power authorization secured and NUBURU’s acquisition completed, I am fully committed to working with the relevant Italian government authorities and contracting bodies to pursue the resumption of selected eligible programs and opportunities placed on hold while the authorization process was pending,” said Gianluca Trezza. “We will address the contractual and technical requirements of each program and align delivery plans with customers and suppliers. Any resumption or new award remains subject to the relevant authorities’ decisions and applicable procurement procedures.” Tekne commercial overview USD millions at 100% of Tekne, grouped by the military and civil classifications in its registers. These programs require reinstatement or new awards, production funding and customer acceptance. Growth through 2031 also depends on securing further new business. The Company intends to build on Tekne’s customer base across Italy, the United States, NATO and allied markets where authorized, extending equipment deliveries through maintenance, upgrades, software and lifecycle support. New integrated offerings remain subject to qualification and customer adoption. NUBURU aims to integrate Tekne into a comprehensive Defense & Security platform, operating as a long-term industrial group with shared engineering, coordinated manufacturing and integrated customer solutions across electronic warfare, special vehicles, photonics, software and lifecycle services. About NUBURU Inc NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is developing a dual-use Defense & Security platform combining electronic warfare and defense mobility, laser and photonics engineering, operational-resilience software and AI-assisted orchestration, and advanced manufacturing and support. Its strategy is to integrate operating businesses and developing technologies into solutions for defense, security, critical-infrastructure and industrial customers. NUBURU’s operating capabilities include Tekne’s special-vehicle and electronic-system engineering, Lyocon’s laser expertise and Orbit’s operational-resilience software. Integrated mission packages and technologies under development remain subject to validation and applicable approvals. For more information, visit www.nuburu.net . articles.summary: DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) ("NUBURU" or the "Company"), a dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company, today announced that it has received formal notice from NYSE American LLC (“NYSE American”) confirming that the Company has regained compliance with all of the NYSE American continued listing standards set forth in Part 10 of the NYSE American Company Guide (the “Company Guide”). On April 29, 2025, NUBURU received a notice of noncompliance from NYSE Regulation indicating that the Company was not in compliance with Section 1003(a)(i) of the Company Guide, which requires a company to maintain stockholders’ equity of $2.0 million or more if it has reported losses from continuing operations or net losses in two of its three most recent fiscal years. On July 22, 2025, NYSE American notified the Company that it had accepted the Company’s plan outlining definitive actions that the Company has taken or will take to regain compliance with NYSE American’s continued listing standards (the “Compliance Plan”) and granted a plan period through October 29, 2026. On May 12, 2026, in light of the reported stockholders’ deficit of approximately $15.2 million as of December 31, 2025 and historical net losses, the Company received a subsequent notice from NYSE Regulation indicating that the Company was not in compliance with Section 1003(a)(ii) of the Company Guide, which requires a company to maintain stockholders’ equity of $4.0 million or more if it has reported losses from continuing operations or net losses in three of its four most recent fiscal years. NYSE American did not require that a new compliance plan be provided with respect to such increased compliance threshold and the Company continued to operate under the Compliance Plan previously accepted by NYSE American. In a letter dated October 29, 2026, NYSE Regulation informed the Company that it has resolved the previously disclosed continued listing deficiencies under Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of the Company Guide. As a result, the "below compliance" (".BC") indicator will no longer be disseminated, and the Company will be removed from the list of NYSE American noncompliant issuers on the NYSE American's website. The Company will remain subject to NYSE Regulation's continued listing monitoring procedures and remains committed to maintaining strong financial discipline and governance going forward. In accordance with Section 1009(h) of the Company Guide, if the Company is again determined to be below any of the continued listing standards within 12 months of the end of the Compliance Plan, NYSE American will examine the relationship between the two incidents of noncompliance and re-evaluate the Company's method of financial recovery from the first incident. NYSE American will then take the appropriate action, which, depending on the circumstances, may include truncating the compliance procedures described in Section 1009 of the NYSE American Company Guide or immediately initiating delisting proceedings. "We are pleased to have resolved this matter and regained full compliance with the NYSE American continued listing standards," said Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer of the Company. About NUBURU NUBURU, Inc. is developing a dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform combining operating businesses and technology-development initiatives. Following completion of its acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne S.p.A. on October 15, 2026, the group brings together Tekne’s electronic-warfare and special-vehicle capabilities, Lyocon’s laser and photonics engineering, and Orbit’s operational-resilience software. NUBURU is focused on integration and commercial execution across defense, security, critical-infrastructure and digital-resilience markets. New integrated capabilities remain subject to technical validation, customer requirements and applicable approvals. For more information, visit www.nuburu.net . These include statements regarding the Company’s regaining and maintaining compliance with the Company Guide and its continued listing on NYSE American, integration of its businesses and commercial execution of its products. articles.summary: DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) ("NUBURU" or the "Company"), a dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company, today announced that it received a public warning letter dated October 19, 2026 from NYSE Regulation on behalf of NYSE American LLC (the "Exchange"). NYSE American warning letter The Exchange issued the warning letter under Section 1009(a)(i) of the NYSE American Company Guide after determining that NUBURU violated Section 401(a), which requires immediate public disclosure of material information. The finding concerns two material events effective September 30, 2026 that the Company disclosed in a Form 8-K filed on October 6, 2026: a side letter with Esousa Group Holdings, LLC and other purchasers related to certain terms of the Company’s July 2026 public offering of common stock, warrants and Series B preferred stock; and an agreement with Brick Lane Capital Management Limited (“Brick Lane”) to return shares of Heckler & Koch AG purchased by the Company from Brick Lane in exchange for cancellation of a $15 million promissory note. The letter cites previous violations by the Company of the Company Guide. In light of that history, NYSE Regulation explicitly stated that any future violation that could lead to a public warning letter under Section 1009 of the Company Guide will instead result in immediate suspension and commencement of delisting proceedings against the Company under Parts 4 and 10 of the Company Guide. The October 19 letter does not itself suspend trading or commence delisting proceedings. This announcement is being made pursuant to Section 401(j) of the Company Guide. About NUBURU NUBURU, Inc. is developing a dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform combining operating businesses and technology-development initiatives. articles.summary: Approximately $3.4 million in advance invoices issued for more than 200 firefighting and emergency-response vehicles within Tekne’s existing program portfolio DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) , the next-generation dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company, today provided an update on procurement and assembly activities under a special-vehicle program valued at approximately $17.1 million (excluding VAT), awarded to Tekne S.p.A. (“Tekne”) by an Italian public-sector customer. NUBURU completed its acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne on October 15, 2026. Tekne issued approximately $3.4 million (excluding VAT) in advance invoices on September 30, 2026, before the acquisition closed. NUBURU intends to provide further updates on material execution milestones. Program Value and Execution Contracted value: approximately $17.1 million, excluding VAT, across two signed contracts with an Italian public-sector customer serving civil-protection and emergency-response needs. Advance invoices issued: approximately $3.4 million, excluding VAT, representing 20% of the combined contract value. Advance billings do not, by themselves, indicate cash received or revenue recognized. Scope: more than 200 vehicles equipped for firefighting and emergency-response applications, with engineering and assembly activities at Tekne’s Italian facilities. Delivery schedule: the two contracts provide for delivery within 180 and 270 calendar days (approximately six and nine months), respectively, following formal notification of customer acceptance of the relevant vehicle prototypes, subject to contractual verification procedures, applicable suspensions and any agreed schedule adjustments. Additional program in the order register: Tekne’s commercial order register separately identifies a program valued at approximately $3.2 million for additional fire-surveillance vehicles within the same public-sector customer group. It is separate from the $17.1 million program and is not being added to previously disclosed aggregate portfolio figures in this release. Delivery and revenue recognition remain subject to execution and the applicable contractual and accounting requirements. Existing Portfolio and Financial Plan Goals The $17.1 million program forms part of Tekne’s existing order and program portfolio, with an estimated normalized residual value of approximately $108.7 million. Tekne’s original May 2026 financial plan, attached to the investment agreement submitted in the Golden Power process, projected approximately $652.3 million in cumulative value of production for 2026–2030. These management projections depend on execution of existing programs and securing additional orders, together with the financing and production capacity needed to deliver them. The plan’s value-of-production measure is not equivalent to consolidated US GAAP revenue, and these projections do not represent NUBURU consolidated US GAAP revenue guidance. This update reports execution and advance billings within the existing portfolio and does not add to the aggregate portfolio total. Tekne was founded in 1990 and employs approximately 185 personnel across facilities in Ortona, Poggiofiorito and Guastalla, Italy, serving defense, civil-protection, public-safety and industrial customers through electronic-warfare capabilities and special-vehicle engineering and manufacturing. NUBURU acquired its 70% controlling interest following authorization by the Italian Government under the Golden Power regime, granted in August 2026. What Tekne Adds to the Platform Emergency response is part of the operational-resilience offering of the NUBURU Defense & Security platform, which helps customers prepare for disruption, respond to incidents and maintain essential operations. Tekne’s specialized vehicles and mission equipment give that offering a physical response layer across civilian and defense-related applications. As part of its integration strategy, NUBURU aims to connect these capabilities with Orbit’s orchestration software to support coordinated operational-resilience workflows, subject to technical validation and customer requirements. The vehicle adaptation, systems integration and field-engineering expertise deployed on this program is the same expertise that underpins Tekne’s defense-mobility capabilities. The same engineering base serves firefighting fleets and defense customers — which is the dual-use model NUBURU’s enlarged platform is built on. Dario Barisoni, Co-Chief Executive Officer of NUBURU and Chief Executive Officer of NUBURU Defense LLC, said: “This program demonstrates the operational capabilities Tekne brings to NUBURU’s Defense & Security platform. With a contracted value of approximately $17.1 million and approximately $3.4 million in advance invoices issued before closing, our focus is on supporting execution, meeting customer requirements and progressing through prototype acceptance, delivery and revenue recognition. We aim to build on Tekne’s engineering and manufacturing base as we integrate the group’s capabilities across defense, emergency response and operational resilience.” US GAAP Revenue Recognition Amounts billed in advance will be recognized as revenue under US GAAP when or as the related performance obligations are satisfied and control of the promised goods or services transfers to the customer, taking account of any substantive acceptance requirements. This release reports an operating and billing milestone; it does not announce a quantified amount of recognized revenue. USD amounts are rounded, exclude VAT and use a reference exchange rate of $1.1551 per euro, consistent with the rate used for the previously disclosed portfolio. Actual US GAAP translation rates may differ. About NUBURU, Inc. NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is the next-generation dual-use Defense and Security integrated platform company. NUBURU is developing software-orchestrated, hardware-enabled capabilities for modern defense and security, critical-infrastructure and digital-resilience markets. The group combines operating businesses and technology-development initiatives across: directed-energy and non-kinetic technologies, including laser and photonics engineering for industrial and defense applications; electronic warfare, including cyber and electromagnetic activities (CEMA), and special-vehicle and defense-mobility programs; operational-resilience software, AI-assisted orchestration and analytics; and advanced manufacturing, integration, support and deployable-production initiatives. NUBURU is focused on commercial execution, integrating its capabilities and converting its opportunity pipeline into contractual orders, revenue and sustained business growth. Product-development and integrated mission programs remain subject to technical validation, customer requirements and applicable approvals. For more information, please visit our website www.nuburu.net and follow us on X https://x.com/nuburulasers . About NUBURU Defense LLC A subsidiary of NUBURU, NUBURU Defense supports the group’s Defense & Security platform and holds a 70% controlling interest in Tekne. NUBURU Defense Italy S.r.l. supports the coordination and development of the Italian platform. For more information on our acquisitions, investments and joint ventures: Orbit: www.orbitopenplatform.com — Orbit provides operational-resilience software, risk intelligence, data integration, workflow orchestration and auditability. Its defense deconfliction module remains under development and institutional validation. Tekne S.p.A.: www.tekne.it — Tekne serves defense, civil-protection, public-safety and industrial customers through electronic-warfare capabilities, special-vehicle engineering and manufacturing. NUBURU completed its acquisition of a 70% controlling interest on October 15, 2026. SunCubes S.r.l.: The group’s collaboration pathway with SunCubes supports exploration of laser power-beaming and optical-communications applications, subject to definitive arrangements, technical validation and applicable approvals. Maddox Defense Incorporated Joint Venture: The group’s joint-venture initiative with Maddox Defense supports advanced manufacturing and deployable-production and sustainment opportunities, subject to program development and execution. A subsidiary of NUBURU, NUBURU Subsidiary, Inc. fully owns Lyocon S.r.l., an Italian laser-technology company specializing in the design, manufacturing and integration of laser systems. Lyocon supports NUBURU’s laser business and the development of dual-use industrial and defense applications. articles.summary: NUBURU Defense Italy in place as Italian sub-holding; Tekne brings approximately $135.4 million in signed orders and approximately 185 personnel to NUBURU’s Defense & Security platform DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) (“NUBURU” or the “Company”), a next-generation dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company, today announced that the parties are targeting October 15, 2026 for the notarial meeting relating to the proposed acquisition, through NUBURU Defense Italy S.r.l. (“NDI”), of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne S.p.A. (“Tekne”), the Italian industrial company founded in 1990 with operations in Ortona, Poggiofiorito and Guastalla. With Golden Power authorization granted by the Italian Government on August 5, 2026 and NDI incorporated, the transaction has cleared its principal regulatory and structural milestones. Completion remains subject to the remaining corporate approvals, notarial formalities and final documentation, together with compliance with the applicable conditions of the Golden Power authorization. The planned October 15 notarial meeting updates the first-week-of-October timetable announced on September 22, 2026. Tekne is intended to become an industrial cornerstone of NUBURU’s Defense & Security platform. Tekne has approximately 185 personnel across its three Italian sites. As previously disclosed on September 22, Tekne management reported approximately $135.4 million in preliminary, unaudited net remaining order value. This figure covers 100% of Tekne and is not U.S. GAAP revenue, a measure of funded backlog or financial guidance. Realization depends on production, delivery, customer acceptance and collection, and orders may be modified, delayed or cancelled. NDI, which is fully controlled by NUBURU Defense LLC, will serve as the Italian sub-holding through which NUBURU Defense LLC holds and manages its controlling interest in Tekne following completion, providing the in-country structure for integration and growth of the Italian platform. “Golden Power authorization has been received and NUBURU Defense Italy is in place. We are now working toward the notarial meeting targeted for October 15 and completion of the remaining transaction requirements,” said Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer of NUBURU. “Tekne would provide NUBURU with an established Italian industrial base, an experienced team and capabilities central to the integrated Defense & Security platform we are building. Our focus now is completion and preparation for integration.” NUBURU will announce completion of the acquisition upon closing. About NUBURU Inc NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is a next-generation dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform company developing software-orchestrated, hardware-enabled capabilities for defense and security, critical infrastructure and digital-resilience markets. Its strategy combines directed-energy and non-kinetic technologies, electronic warfare and defense mobility, operational-resilience software and AI-assisted orchestration, and advanced manufacturing and support. For more information, visit www.nuburu.net and https://ir.nuburu.net/corporate-profile/default.aspx , and follow NUBURU on X at https://x.com/nuburulasers . About NUBURU Defense LLC A subsidiary of NUBURU, NUBURU Defense LLC supports the development of the Company’s Defense & Security platform. NUBURU Defense Italy S.r.l. has been established to support the coordination and development of the Italian platform and the proposed Tekne acquisition. The acquisition remains subject to completion of the closing requirements described above. About NUBURU Subsidiary Inc A subsidiary of NUBURU, NUBURU Subsidiary, Inc. fully owns Lyocon S.r.l., an Italian laser-technology company specializing in the design, manufacturing and integration of laser systems. Lyocon supports NUBURU’s laser business and the development of dual-use industrial and defense applications.
